description: Search the live NOSTOS catalog of retro games, consoles, and vintage apparel. Free-text query (accents optional) plus platform, department, region, condition, and price filters. Returns items for sale online and in the Duluth shop, title matches first; each says how to buy it (howToBuy). Every item is individually graded.

includeSold.description: Include sold items too. Default false.

onlineOnly.description: Only items that can be bought online. Default false: in-store-only items are included, each with its howToBuy.

platform.description: Filter by platform (case-insensitive substring), e.g. 'Saturn', 'N64', 'Game Boy'.

query.description: Free-text match across name, description, genre, and platform. All words must match.

region.description: Filter by exact region code, e.g. 'JP', 'US', 'PAL'.

name: search_inventory
title: Search the catalog
